title: The Homeland Security Task Force launches the Threat Disruption Center to fight crypto fraud and cybercrime, using TRM Labs' AI platform via a ~$95M no-bid deal (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: The Homeland Security Task Force launches the Threat Disruption Center to fight crypto fraud and cybercrime, using TRM Labs' AI platform via a ~$95M no-bid deal — The Trump administration is launching a new effort to combat a surge in crypto fraud and other cybercrimes targeting Americans …
